claim: Champions' slp.onStart (data/mods/champions/conditions.ts:23) draws `this.sample([2,3,3])`. The middle arm addresses a draw by the SCOPE it was made in — game_differential wraps BattleActions#secondaries as category `sec`. A sleep applied from inside a secondary therefore draws its timer under `sec` in the authority, and medicham2 drew every timer under `any` via medRng(). Two categories are two independent dice.
evidence_before_the_fix: pinned pool, pair-protect-bust ...bo3-2660356793 vs ...bo3-2660492912: a Golurk slept by Dire Claw on t2 got slpTime 3 here and startTime 2 there; at t6 this engine wrote |cant|slp and the authority |-curestatus|slp|[msg]. Whole-game `any` address log: sd=0 me=3 shared=0, this engine's extra draw reading 20260813|2|any|direclaw|p10|0.
fix: applyStatus takes the caller's stream and hands it to sleepDurationDraw; the proceduralStatus site passes _R.sec. MEDI_SLEEP_START_ANY_ADDR=1 restores the old bucket.
